BiblicalUsage: Bunah was a son of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, named among the sons of Judah's line in the genealogy. He is one of the names that carry the family from Hezron toward David.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps every link in the chain, and Bunah is remembered because his family line mattered.
